verdict.rationale: The iOS App Store listing (chatgpt-docs-20/21/41/52/58/59) documents rich mobile features—voice mode, photo upload, image generation, stickers—confirming a full-featured iOS app, and doc references (chatgpt-docs-67) explicitly mention continuing tasks 'in ChatGPT Work on the web, iOS, or Android,' indicating Android parity.
